scripts.dev:web: npm run ensure:text-wasm && npm run dev -w @lighttable/web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run ensure:text-wasm && npm run start -w @lighttable/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run package:desktop
scripts.build:web: npm run ensure:text-wasm && npm run build -w @lighttable/web
scripts.package:desktop: npm run ensure:text-wasm && npm run package -w @lighttable/desktop
scripts.package:desktop:verify: npm run ensure:text-wasm && npm run package -w @lighttable/desktop
scripts.screenshot:desktop:build: npm run package:desktop:verify && npm run screenshot:desktop --
scripts.stress:desktop:build: npm run package:desktop:verify && npm run stress:desktop --
scripts.smoke:desktop:commands:build: npm run package:desktop:verify && npm run smoke:desktop:commands --
scripts.smoke:desktop:tight-merge:build: npm run package:desktop:verify && npm run smoke:desktop:tight-merge --
scripts.smoke:desktop:system-fonts:build: npm run package:desktop:verify && npm run smoke:desktop:system-fonts --
scripts.smoke:desktop:paragraph:build: npm run package:desktop:verify && npm run smoke:desktop:paragraph --
scripts.make:desktop: npm run ensure:text-wasm && npm run make -w @lighttable/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:text-wasm && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run ensure:text-wasm && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run verify:boundary && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web && npm run package:desktop:verify
